name: bicycle42
description: bicycle 42: a standalone design-review app. The page is the interface; a coding agent, run over ACP here or on another computer over ssh, does the work.

scripts.dist: node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/release-files.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs --tests && node scripts/unit.mjs && electron --ozone-platform=headless --disable-gpu dist/test/page.e2e.cjs && electron --ozone-platform=headless --disable-gpu dist/test/extensions.e2e.cjs && electron --ozone-platform=headless --disable-gpu dist/test/app.e2e.cjs
